central_problem: 從『這篇在說什麼』到『我能安全主張什麼』，中間需要什麼資料結構？
reader_takeaway: claim、citation、source identity、review/safety state 與定位要一起移動。

known_at_the_time.fact: frontend evidence-card flow 在 6/16 開始演化，backend evidenceCardBuilder/evidenceSchema 在 6/26 committed tree 出現。
source records、review and evidence pipeline were distinct from later canonical admission。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: evidence cards became structured downstream material derived from reviewed/accepted sources, rather than plain provider abstracts。

not_yet_available.fact: Study Facts V2 status taxonomy and canonical owner revision binding were not committed at this stage。

observed_failures.symptom: a summary/evidence card could be mistaken for a complete study-level fact record
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: early card contract was less complete than later facts/provenance model
observed_failures.later_resolution: later Study Facts and canonical admission distinguish missing, unknown and admitted states

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: One evidence-card transport layer is identifiable; no card-count or pass-rate claim is made.

engineering_decisions.decision: 讓 Evidence Card 作為可追蹤的 transport contract；不讓它自行取得最終 evidence authority。

architecture_state.state: accepted source → evidence card → report synthesis

safe_public_facts.fact: 摘要是輸入材料之一，但 Evidence Card 應保存能回到 source 的 claim/citation context。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來 card 會攜帶 owner-issued admission/provenance projection；早期 card 不應被描寫成同樣完整。

publication_risks: 不要把 current card schema 當成 6 月 schema。
不要公開 raw evidence payload。
